snippet.title: Danger in Pompeii - Official trailer
snippet.description:
Danger in Pompeii is an adventure puzzle game where you relive the last day of the famous Roman city. Explore its streets, help its inhabitants, and solve Mercury’s mystery to escape the eruption of the Vesuvius and save your loved ones!

Danger in Pompeii will be released on Steam during July 2025. 
Demo available for free during Steam Neo Fest, June 9th to 16th!

Wishlist to stay tuned: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592920/Danger__Pompi/
